mission: Arrival at the Battlefield Node — first Corridor stop. NSW battlefield world, rolling terrain, weathered military history. The anchor installation is a bunker with an empty stasis chamber.
why_now: First node exploration establishes the pattern for subsequent stops — baseline for thin places and Veraine's trail
conflict: The thin place is mild but real — Ben's Force perception has a parallax error, distances wrong. The survivors react differently: Sera tightens, Torin relaxes, Kael goes blank.
turning_point: Inside the bunker, the stasis chamber is empty — anchor died centuries ago. But the installation records show someone accessed them recently. Fresh marks in ancient dust.
opening_hook: The battlefield world looks peaceful from orbit. On the ground, the rolling terrain is still shaped by trenches a thousand years old, eroded into gentle valleys that nature made beautiful and war made first.
closing_hook: Fresh boot prints in dust that hasn't been disturbed in centuries. Someone walked these corridors weeks ago.
emotional_trajectory: Archaeological curiosity -> the wrongness making itself felt -> alertness at recent evidence

stakes.personal: Ben's first experience of a thin place — his Force perception becoming unreliable
stakes.interpersonal: The survivors' different reactions to thin places reveal their inner states
stakes.external: Veraine was here — the trail goes warm

setting: Battlefield Node world — rolling terrain with ancient military earthworks, bunker-style anchor installation
sensory_details: Corroded war machinery half-buried in grass; depressions that were trenches now gentle dips; inside the bunker: cold, dry, preserved; the thin place's effect on Force-senses — reaching for the handrail and finding it six inches further away
promises_planted: The full de-structured experience will be delivered (PP17)
notes: Establish the Corridor as a trail of thin places. Torin's relaxation in the thin place is a subtle warning — he shouldn't be comfortable here. The institutional lie subplot threads: Ben notices the Corridor isn't in any modern Jedi record.
